column1: # hardware-properties: every cited rung measurement, replayed against the rung rules (`rules.rs`, test
# `rung_rules_replay`). One line per measurement class: the part it ran on (its hand profile's physical properties),
# the fill (n<N>: the square N-cell's base grid on that part; U0 / U1: 0 / 1 warps per scheduler; U: both; F: >= 2;
# A: every fill), the face (E exact, C contract, T TF32; letters combine), the winner (on / off: beyond its null and
# stable; null: inside the null or a sign that changed between sessions; mixed: the part's own cells disagree), a
# condition the part's profile does not carry (pageable_pm=<host ratio>, colmajor: the fold's operand stored
# column-major, blocks=<the row-fitted grid's blocks>, l2-flushed, free-order, conv-site), and the source (results files under benches/results/gpu/ and
# benches/results/evidence/; the former GPU_RUNGS_OFF rows' cites, f3a9e792).
# A cond may name a measured property of the box the part's profile does not carry (`<cost name>=<value>`, e.g. a
# power-capped clock) or the site's side of a priced rule (`row_bytes=`: a retained row's k x c operand bytes;
# `repeats=1|0`: the module's launches repeat in a loop or not; `split=tf32x3|narrow1`: the split form whose passes the
# part's matrix and FFMA rates price, `rules::split_rate_pays`), comma-separated. cross-arch lines: the round on
